name: yanzhi_met_fit3_front
title: 胭脂红卡：第三版灯 + 机位下方的正面补光(S8 r3 的检验)
what: S8 r2: the inside's reflections in the photo are about a third of the round-2 rig's in width and height (blob w 0.16-0.18 / h 0.25-0.30 of the bowl against 0.49-0.51 / 0.70, lightfit/fit.py blobs) [M]; the round-2 rear pair's reflections (u +-0.85) are not in the photo; two smaller blobs near the far rim (u -0.40 v 0.09, u +0.52 v 0.16) [M] read as a higher pair at the same azimuths. Groups: main, high, bg (lamps behind the bowl lighting the sweep's wall). A low side pair was tried (render D) and dropped: its reflections (u +-0.68, v 0.77) are not in the photo. Strengths fitted by lightfit/fit3.py. S8 r3 test: a front fill under the camera (group front) [A]: the photo foot ring is 2-6x brighter in R than the render [M] and the floor just in front of the foot 1.3x; a large dim source low on the camera side would light both without a reflection on the front wall (the front wall reflects the floor, 56 degrees down [D]).

spectrum.why: v0: every lamp of a rig has the same spectrum, the key light rgbscene projects with, so one bounce is exact (docs/optics.md); 5500 K blackbody: a stand-in for daylight-balanced studio flash or LED, our choice

lamps.name: mainL
lamps.why: [F] the left reflection in the inside's far wall, photo u -0.38 v 0.52 (probe az 60 el 45: -0.37, 0.60; el 60: 0.30); size 220 mm [F: the blobs' width ratio 0.17 / 0.5 x 600 mm]

lamps.name: mainR
lamps.why: [F] the right reflection, photo u +0.45 v 0.54 (probe az 75 el 45: +0.46, 0.58); the photo's pair is not symmetric; size 220 mm [F: the blobs' width ratio 0.17 / 0.5 x 600 mm]

lamps.name: highL
lamps.why: [F] the photo's small blobs near the far rim (u -0.40 v 0.09, u +0.52 v 0.16) [M]: at el 68 this pair's blob sat at v 0.28 (render D), so 78; same azimuths as the main pair [A]; 250 lux = 0.25 x the main pair [F, lightfit/fit3.py on render E]; S8 r3: 187.5 lux (0.75 x 250) refitted with the front fill [F]

lamps.name: highR
lamps.why: [F] the photo's small blobs near the far rim (u -0.40 v 0.09, u +0.52 v 0.16) [M]: at el 68 this pair's blob sat at v 0.28 (render D), so 78; same azimuths as the main pair [A]; 250 lux = 0.25 x the main pair [F, lightfit/fit3.py on render E]; S8 r3: 187.5 lux (0.75 x 250) refitted with the front fill [F]

lamps.name: bgL
lamps.why: [A] background lights behind the bowl aimed at the sweep's wall (common studio practice, not seen in the photo): the photo's backdrop is 0.66-0.73 of the inside's white, the main and high pairs alone give less (render D: backdrop residual 0.7 in log); 750 lux at the wall = 0.75 x [F, lightfit/fit3.py on render E]

lamps.name: bgR
lamps.why: [A] background lights behind the bowl aimed at the sweep's wall (common studio practice, not seen in the photo): the photo's backdrop is 0.66-0.73 of the inside's white, the main and high pairs alone give less (render D: backdrop residual 0.7 in log); 750 lux at the wall = 0.75 x [F, lightfit/fit3.py on render E]

lamps.name: front
lamps.why: [A] S8 r3 test: a low front fill (a bounce card or softbox under the lens is common on a copy stand); its strength is fitted per light group (fit3.py); 225 lux = 0.75 x the 300 lux test [F, lightfit/fit3.py on out/s8/yanzhi/r3/render/front: score 1.187, against 1.241 without it]

backdrop.why: [F/A] the photo's backdrop is 0.66-0.73 of the inside's white and the wall's neutral sheen (G channel) needs a bright surround: rgfit.py's best reflectance 0.72-0.84; white_90 is the nearest material in optics/backdrops.json (rho 0.84 scores 0.685 against 0.650)
